environment: Android 15 / WebView 124 / WHPX emulator; not a physical phone

checks.name: Create an empty course and select it as the import destination
System picker imports several HTML/HTM documents at once; identical titles remain separate
Mixed batch keeps valid imports, skips an exact duplicate and reports the invalid file
GBK HTML, UTF-16 HTML and body-only fragments render Chinese text and run their own interactions
Different HTML layouts sharing the same localStorage key remain isolated across force-stop and relaunch
Search filters actual file names and provides a recoverable no-results state
Rename, pin and explicitly update an HTML while preserving its custom name and progress
Move documents between courses, rename a course and sort while respecting pinned items
Complete backup restores course classification, file name, custom label, pin and the original learning state
Portable backups can add a Chinese-named course with separate progress
Removing a course classification keeps all HTML and learning records
Deleting one HTML does not delete other courses or their progress
Course library, search and fixed import action remain usable with dark mode and enlarged text
